peak frequency of postbounce PNS oscillations (Richers et al. 2017): largest feature of |FT(D*h+ up to t_bounce_signal_end + 6 ms)| - |FT(D*h+ up to t_bounce_signal_end)|, searched in 600-1075 Hz for the intermediate-Omega_0 run of each (progenitor, EOS, A) sequence and in a 75 Hz window centred on the adjacent run otherwise; if the run ends up to 0.3 ms before t_bounce_signal_end + 6 ms the window ends at the last sample. Exception (deviation from the published method): for s40, A = 300 km, SFHo, omega_0 = 4.0-8.0 rad/s (9 runs) the strongest feature in 600-1075 Hz (~820 Hz mode) instead of the tracked ~1000 Hz mode.
